title: Balance-based term of an interest-free payment plan on the Continence Commercial HMO Program
content:
An interest-free payment plan for the balance of a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program has its term in months set by the size of the covered balance against the tier's smallest plan balance.

## Term

The covered balance is the program's balance as the ledger stands when the plan is accepted.

| Covered balance | Term |
|---|---|
| below twice the tier's smallest plan balance | replaced by 3 months |
| at least twice but below four times that balance | replaced by the tier's longest term less 2 months |
| four times that balance or more | stays the tier's longest term |

On the Continence Commercial HMO Program the smallest plan balance is 150.00 USD and the longest term is 6 months. The thresholds are therefore 300.00 USD and 600.00 USD, and the middle row gives 6 less 2, which is 4 months.

## Boundaries (hypothetical balances)

| Covered balance | Term |
|---|---|
| 299.99 USD | 3 months |
| 300.00 USD | 4 months |
| 599.99 USD | 4 months |
| 600.00 USD | 6 months |
